notes: OMI News, the Ocean View-Merced Heights-Ingleside Community Association's paper, every issue in the Internet Archive collection sanfrancisconewspapers: 85 items, May 1969 to 1980. Source text is each item's hOCR search text; leaves from its hOCR page index. extra.candidate is the window number in the run's scratch merge.

coverage.remaining: Nothing in this title. Unread titles in the collection: see glen-park-1977-2012.json and the dossier.
coverage.note: 825 OCR pages; 5,605 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets (with --untyped for the title's own main streets). ocr_mentions.py kept 231 windows; 486 advertisement- or advertiser-dropped windows carrying a strong event word were added back: 717 windows read by hand by four readers. 156 candidates; 120 set aside before entry - bare occupancy of an institution with no event (most of them: library, school and church addresses in calendars and directories), repeats of one event across issues, display advertisements, a proposal never confirmed, businesses named for their proprietor, and contact addresses. 36 findings written.
